data.rationale: The proposal captures the right goal (Find a Park, filter by activity/topic/state, then Search) but is vaguer than the true workflow: it omits the explicit "Search by Activity or Topic" click, splits the filter into separate activity/topic parameters instead of filter_type/filter_values, and adds an unneeded scroll step, so an automation would need guesswork.
